review_brief:
# Review: d8111f3f714d branch-direction extension
Task/source: `d8111f3f714d`, generator `3.0.0`, baseline SHA-256 `e1342ed093a0d42631ed17aa27faafc50c4bdf4a6aa003d0950f960a7d229e65` → final `31cd4a04282f3a8dd56008ccd12895aa2879cd8ed0a7c5161029cd7a5b21f4ab`.
Defect → repair: the approved generator had no machine-checkable lesson contract; added five finite rivals and `lesson_identifiable` without changing generation or canonical labels.
Canonical authority: rule hash `2a9d26bd68ef` and exact canonical Racket program remain unchanged; no canonical ledger patch was made.
Prototype: added opt-in episode-fixed `branch_direction={toward_trunk,away_to_edge}` with 3 demonstrations and 4 distinct Racket-labelled queries per setting.
Default preservation: `toward_trunk` emits the exact canonical program bytes; `away_to_edge` retains the trunk and sends branch rays away from it to the boundary.
Semantic evidence: baseline was `NO_CONTRACT`; final source passes 12/12 sampled easy/medium/hard lesson audits and rejects a concrete one-sided shortcut lesson.
Focused verification: 13 authored tests pass, including vertical/horizontal parity, branch counts 1/5, boundary rays, count/type rejection, privacy, visible-content IDs, and deterministic public-ID ordering.
Supplementary tickets: the NVARC blind prediction matched and all 30 pairs fit one rule; a source-pinned peer witness refuted `memorize_one_output_per_control` with Python/Racket parity.
Remaining failure: the issued legacy selected test still fails during collection because its projected import/data layout is absent; this is recorded, not counted as a pass.
Storage study: only the `before_package` checkpoint was captured; `before_extract`, `after_extract`, and `after_setup` were missed and were not reconstructed.
Status: routine source-bound prototype/semantic repair; maintainer replay is still required, and neither packaging nor this proposal grants production or training approval.
scope: Retain raw/staged collection differences, finite sampler/gate limits, and unchanged earlier adversarial-source receipts; peer findings remain separately source-bound.
